feature_added.title: A new puppet joins the cast
feature_added.narration: A new puppet walks on stage. {summary}

behaviour_changed.title: The script was rewritten
behaviour_changed.narration: The script turns to a new page. {summary}

secret_exposed.title: The stage key hangs outside
secret_exposed.narration: The key to the stage door is hanging outside, where anyone can take it. {summary}

fix.narration: With the key kept inside, only the crew can open the door.

missing_safety_limit.title: A string with no knot
missing_safety_limit.narration: This string has no knot at the end, so nothing stops it running out. {summary}

fix.narration: A knot at the end means the string can only go so far.

unit_mismatch.title: Two rulers that disagree
unit_mismatch.narration: Two stagehands measure with different rulers. {summary}

fix.narration: Now everyone measures with the same ruler.

error_hidden.title: The puppet bows with a snapped string
error_hidden.narration: The puppet takes a bow, but its string has snapped. {summary}

fix.narration: Now a snapped string stops the show, so someone can mend it.

no_timeout.title: Nobody calls time
no_timeout.narration: The hourglass keeps turning and nobody calls time. {summary}

fix.narration: Now the stage manager calls time if the scene runs too long.

no_human_approval.title: The director's chair is empty
no_human_approval.narration: The director's chair is empty: nobody says yes before the curtain rises. {summary}

fix.narration: Now the director nods before anything moves.

tests_added.title: The cast rehearsed
tests_added.narration: The cast rehearsed this before opening night. {summary}

tests_missing.title: No rehearsal
tests_missing.narration: This scene goes on without a single rehearsal. {summary}

fix.narration: With a rehearsal, mistakes show up before the audience arrives.

dependency_added.title: A crate from another theatre
dependency_added.narration: A crate of props arrives from another theatre. {summary}
